title: Converter Manifest (Stage 2)
description: Manifest written by the convert-findings skill (Converter stage 2). Tracks per-skeleton processing with skeleton-level checkpointing, destination routing, and closed vocabulary for issues. Read by the skill on startup to resume from the last unprocessed skeleton.

status.description: Current state of the stage 2 run. 'pending' is the initial state before any skeleton is processed. 'in_progress' means skeletons are being processed. 'complete' means all skeletons from stage 1 have been routed to either packets/ or source_intake_gpt_recovery/. 'failed' means the run stopped with an unrecoverable error and requires manual intervention. 'blocked_by_stage_1_incomplete' means stage 2 started but detected that stage 1 is not complete and exited without processing anything.

stage_1_manifest_path.description: Path to the stage 1 manifest that was consumed by this run. Recorded so the operator can trace which stage 1 output produced which stage 2 output.

conversion_template_path.description: Path to the conversion template that the skill used as reference. Recorded for auditability: if the template changes in the future, this field identifies which version of the template produced these packets.

source_packet_schema_path.description: Path to the Source Packet schema used for validation. Recorded for auditability.

total_skeletons.description: Total number of skeletons in the input (read from the stage 1 manifest). Equal to skeletons_processed + remaining unprocessed skeletons.

skeletons_processed.description: Count of skeletons that have been processed so far. Equal to the length of processed_skeletons plus the length of skeleton_failures. Updated after each skeleton completes.

packets_written.description: Count of packets successfully validated and written to working/source_intake/packets/. Subset of skeletons_processed.

recovery_staged.description: Count of packets that failed validation and were staged to working/source_intake/source_intake_gpt_recovery/. Subset of skeletons_processed.

needs_human_review_count.description: Count of packets that were written to packets/ but are flagged as needing human review (4+ uncertainties or high-severity uncertainty). This is a subset of packets_written, not a separate destination.

processed_skeletons.description: Per-skeleton record of what happened. Grows by one entry each time a skeleton is processed. Used for resumption: on restart, any skeleton already in this list is skipped. Only contains skeletons that had valid structure and were processed to completion (either written to packets/ or routed to recovery). Skeletons that failed initial structure validation go to skeleton_failures instead.

packet_id.description: The packet_id as assigned by stage 1. Format: SP-<shard_id>-<NNN>.

destination.description: Where this packet was written. 'packets' means it passed validation and is in working/source_intake/packets/. 'source_intake_gpt_recovery' means it failed validation and is staged for GPT recovery.

issues_for_this_packet.description: Issue types registered for this specific packet during processing. Empty array if the packet was processed cleanly. May contain multiple entries if several issues apply (e.g., template_case_uncovered and needs_human_review).

processed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone when this skeleton finished processing.

skeleton_failures.description: Skeletons that failed pre-processing validation and never became packets. These are structural failures of the skeleton file itself (missing mechanical fields, malformed JSON). They do not appear in processed_skeletons because they never reached the judgment-filling stage.

skeleton_filename.description: Filename of the skeleton that failed (not packet_id, because the skeleton never became a packet).

issue_type.description: Only one issue type applies to skeleton failures at this stage: skeleton_invalid. If new failure modes arise, add them to this enum before the skill can register them.

detail.description: Human-readable description of why the skeleton failed (e.g., 'Missing mechanical field: source_ref', 'JSON parse error at line 42').

failed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone when the failure was detected.

stage_1_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex digest computed from the sorted filenames and sizes of all skeleton files in working/source_intake/skeleton_batches/. Recorded so that if stage 1 is re-run (producing different skeletons), stage 2 can detect the change on restart and refuse to resume against a different input set.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone, recorded when the run first started. Preserved across resumptions.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone, recorded when the run finished successfully with status='complete'. Null while the run is in progress, failed, or blocked.
